listing.name: SSX 3 (PlayStation 2) (SSX 3 native Rust port)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Source only, Python setup translates own disc followed by Cargo build. No GitHub releases. Limits: Upstream says races/events/campaign playable; macOS tested, Linux build/tests pass but gameplay untested. Source only. Upstream platforms: Source only. macOS Apple-Silicon ARM64 developed/tested upstream; Ubuntu24.04 Linux x86-64 setup/build/tests work, gameplay untested. Windows native tooling documented; selected Windows CPU target unestablished. Original data: User-owned SSX 3 USA SLUS-20772 ISO, executable hash checked. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
